title: Audit events the contract tests may assert, contract v1.1 (v1-d4 + S2a location login config)
description: Event list [SRC: PLAN §3.1 L148-161; LD §8 L417-427]. Envelope names [SRC: AUD §7A.4]; login-specific mapping [SRC: LD §8 L424]. Tenant fields are in the nested scope.* envelope (scope.partner_id, scope.cachd_client_id, scope.location_ids) per AUD §7A.4, with scope.client_id renamed scope.cachd_client_id [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-23, OQ-37] (LD §16.19 row 114 L701, §16.19.4 L1443). Tokens stay flat (claims.schema.json).

category.description: Events category [SRC: LD §8 L413]. Literal 'event' [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-23].

event_type.description: auth.* names only; iam.permission.change_requested renamed auth.provider.change_requested [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-38] (LD §8 L427, row 115 L702). v1.1: auth.provider.change_requested is no longer an event at all [Confirmed DEC-096; LD §4.1 L178, §17 item 15].

user_id.description: = sub; null when the user is unknown (failed sign-in) [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24].

source.description: service, versions [SRC: AUD §7A.4]; ip, user_agent [SRC: LD L417, L424].

outcome.description: success / failure / denied [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-23/OQ-24]; success and denied appear in LD L424, L426.

x_standin.description: Stand-in events only; the audit relay/ingest outside Development rejects and alerts on any event carrying it [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-25].

scope.description: Tenant scope [SRC: AUD §7A.4] [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-37]. cachd_client_id absent for partner-level users; location_ids absent for /admin [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15], or [] for an /admin event where no location applies; any other event needs ≥1 item [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:29 PM].

cachd_client_id.description: The Cachd client (casino operator), not the OAuth client [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-23, OQ-37].

location_ids.description: Array: one event can cover several locations (AUD §7A.4 L266, multi-location for admin actions); a session/token carries the single location_id; for a one-session event = [location_id] (contract 8.11) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:26 PM].

admin_type.description: Present only on events from an /admin session; copied from the token's admin_type. Its presence is the switch that allows scope.location_ids: [] [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:29 PM]. Not yet in AUD §7A.4: open item AUD v0.8 [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:31 PM].

session_kind.description: Present when the event belongs to a login session; copied from the session (contract 7.8). Not yet in AUD §7A.4: open item AUD v0.8 [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:35 PM].

allOf.description: Without admin_type: scope.location_ids required, ≥1 item [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:29 PM; TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:31 PM]. Single exemption [TLD 2026-11-04 9:04, OQ-P3-2]: a refused location create (auth.config.change_denied, setting location_login_config, operation create, details.location_id null), which has no location yet; its branch then requires scope.location_ids [].

auth.login.succeeded.description: [SRC: LD §8 L417]. Optional detail attestation [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-11] (TL Rec to the SA for LD §8 L417).

config_row_version.description: OPTIONAL in v1.1: auth.location_login_config.row_version the sign-in used (Entra and database locations) [TLD 2026-11-04 7:45, SSE2 F16].

attestation.description: Plain sign-in attestation result; optional [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-11]. Never makes the session 'attested'.

auth.login.failed.description: [SRC: LD §8 L418; PLAN L150]. Never the password.

username_hmac.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 with a secret key over the normalized username (trim, Unicode NFKC, lowercase invariant) [SRC: LD L418; TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24]. Stand-in key is test-only.

reason.description: Known codes: remote_session [SRC: LD L418]; locked, mfa_missing, tenant_mismatch, stale_auth_time [SRC: PLAN L146]; bad_credentials covers both unknown user and wrong password (no existence oracle), outbox_unavailable [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24] (LD §16.19.5); no password_expired reason [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24]. rate_limited is not an outbox reason (LD §8 L431). Full list per LD §16.19.5 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24]. v1.1: not_location_user = an Entra sign-in refused because the user is not a user of that location (partner_id null or not the location's partner, or no auth.user_location assignment; spec A-22) [TLD 2026-11-04 8:30].

config_row_version.description: OPTIONAL in v1.1: auth.location_login_config.row_version the sign-in used (Entra and database locations) [TLD 2026-11-04 7:45, SSE2 F16].

auth.account.locked.description: [SRC: LD §8 L419]; 10 tries / 30 min [SRC: PLAN L34].

auth.account.unlocked.description: Who unlocked, user unlocked, identity check used [SRC: LD §8 L419].

step.description: reenroll: wrong totp_code on POST /mfa/reenroll [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:41 PM, SA ratification]. Absent for sign-in MFA.

reason.description: rate_limited: re-enrol POST TOTP rate limit tripped (contract 7.8) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:48 PM]. Only with step=reenroll.

allOf.description: A re-enrolment failure carries session_kind=recovery_reenroll [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:41 PM, SA ratification]. Details closed (method, step, reason only; no totp_code echo) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:48 PM].
reason=rate_limited only on auth.mfa.failed with step=reenroll [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:48 PM].

auth.session.revoked.description: reason, actor [SRC: LD §8 L423]. One per login session ended, not per client/token [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-10]. reason=user_disabled when refresh finds the user disabled or locked [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-12]. Other values [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24]. reason=reenrolled: the recovery_reenroll session ends right after auth.mfa.reenrolled [Confirmed DEC-087].

allOf.description: reason=reenrolled only for a recovery_reenroll session [Confirmed DEC-087].

auth.app.signed_in.description: [SRC: LD §8 L424; PLAN L156, S1 check 2]. One per code issued.

allOf.description: No app sign-in from a recovery_reenroll session [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:35 PM].

auth.app_access.denied.description: [SRC: LD §8 L426; PLAN §1.2 L51, L157, S1 checks 1, 4, 4a].

reason.description: notfromhub: rule 4, hub_launch missing or used [SRC: LD L426, L1186; TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-7]. not_location_user: an /admin session (admin_type super or partner) asked for the Cash Advance hand-off [Confirmed DEC-084]. recovery_session: a recovery_reenroll session (recovery-code sign-in, amr [pwd]) asked for the hand-off, an app launch or hub_launch [Confirmed DEC-085].

allOf.description: reason recovery_session only for a recovery_reenroll session [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:35 PM].

auth.password.reset.description: Defined, not emitted in S1 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-26]. [SRC: LD §8 L421]. Channel values email | admin [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24].

provider_state.description: v1.1 S2a. before/after state of a location login config: exactly these keys, never secret_ref or any secret [SRC: LD §4.1 L184] [Confirmed DEC-096, DEC-098]. Same shape as location-login-config.schema.json $defs.audited_state.

login_config_field.description: v1.1 S2a. Field NAMES only, never values (secret_ref = set or cleared by the server from deployment config Entra:SecretRef [TLD 2026-11-04 9:49, D-51]).

auth.provider.changed.description: v1.1 (S2a, contract/v1.1-S2a-location-login-config.md §7). Emitted for every applied create/update of a location login config, by Super Admin or Partner Admin, in the SAME Transaction DB transaction as the config row and the auth.location_login_config_change row, fail-closed [SRC: LD §4.1 L184; Confirmed DEC-096]. v1 approval_id REMOVED (no four-eyes, DEC-096; LD §8 L436 strike). Details closed; no secret values ever. row_version added at SSE2's request (v1.1). Downgrades (mfa_required true->false, allow_db_fallback false->true, or created with mfa_required false / allow_db_fallback true) require admin_type super and a non-empty reason [Confirmed DEC-096, DEC-098].

row_version.description: Config row_version AFTER the change (v1.1, SSE2 request).

reason.description: Stored and emitted TRIMMED: null, or 10..500 characters after trim [TLD 2026-11-04 7:39, OQ-S2a-7]; the server applies LoginConfig:ReasonMinLength..ReasonMaxLength, always inside 10..500 (DB CHECK llcc_reason) [DEC-107, TLD 2026-11-04 16:32 Q1=A].

downgrade_rule.description: v1.1 S2a: a downgrade is Super Admin only with a written reason, 10..500 characters after trim [Confirmed DEC-096 (fallback), DEC-098 (MFA off); TLD 2026-11-04 7:39 (length)].

not_emitted_fields_not_stated.description: Defined, not emitted in S1 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-26]. In LD §8 L427 with no fields stated (envelope only) [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-25]. v1.1: auth.provider.change_requested removed from this list: Partner Admin method changes apply immediately with no request event [Confirmed DEC-096; LD §4.1 L178, §17 item 15].

fields_not_stated.description: In the list [SRC: PLAN L158-160; LD §8 L427] but no fields are stated anywhere. Envelope only until the SA states fields [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-25].

auth.mfa.reenrolled.description: MFA re-enrolment confirmed (POST, contract 7.8) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:37 PM]. Old TOTP secret and every old recovery code revoked at once.

auth.mfa.recovery_codes_issued.description: New recovery codes issued (contract 7.8) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:37 PM]. Count only; the codes are never logged (details allows only count). Emitted with auth.mfa.reenrolled on a successful POST /mfa/reenroll; session_kind required (recovery_reenroll there; normal at first enrolment [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:42 PM]) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:41 PM, SA ratification].

session_kind.description: Follows the context: recovery_reenroll on the re-enrol path, normal at first enrolment [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:42 PM].

auth.config.session_cap_changed.description: LoginService:Session:AbsoluteLifetime changed (contract 7.4) [Confirmed OQ-40 partial] (Mohanraj 8:35 PM PT: "super admin or Partner Admin"). Only admin_type super or partner; old value, new value and actor required. Not in AUD: AUD v0.8 item.

old_value.description: TimeSpan text, e.g. 12:00:00. No range enforced (OQ-40 range open).

new_value.description: TimeSpan text, e.g. 12:00:00. No range enforced (OQ-40 range open).

auth.config.change_denied.description: v1.1: a refused admin change. Exactly one branch by target.type: config (v1 body, unchanged) or location_login_config / partner (S2a, contract/v1.1-S2a-location-login-config.md §7.2).

auth.config.change_denied.location_login.description: v1.1 S2a. Refused location login config create/update [TL Decision, S2a brief: 'refusals emit a denied event'] [Confirmed DEC-098: Partner Admin downgrade -> denied, reason not_super_admin]. target = the location (update) or the partner (create, no location yet; details.location_id null) [TLD 2026-11-04 9:04, OQ-P3-2]. scope.partner_id = the TARGET's partner (ASSUMPTION A-6); actor_partner_id = the Partner Admin's own partner. Details closed: field NAMES only, never values (no secret_ref, no tenant id). Reasons: not_admin (no admin_type / permission not held by a built-in admin role), forbidden_scope (Partner Admin, other partner's location or partner; the client sees 404 not_found [TLD 2026-11-04 7:39, OQ-S2a-3]), not_super_admin (Partner Admin downgrade), tenant_bound_elsewhere (tenant already used by another partner's location; Super Admin too).

location_id.description: The location (update) or null (create: no location yet) [TLD 2026-11-04 9:04, OQ-P3-2]. Null is allowed on this branch only, and only with operation create.

reason.description: forbidden_scope replaces S2a wrong_partner [TLD 2026-11-04 7:39, OQ-S2a-3]: the client gets 404 not_found, the attempt is still audited.

allOf.description: target.id and scope.partner_id are required, except on a refused create by a non-admin whose body gave no valid partner_id: then BOTH are absent (never one without the other) [TLD 2026-11-04 9:04, OQ-P3-2/-8; OQ-P3-10].

auth.config.change_denied.config.description: A refused config change (contract 7.4) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:39 PM]. Actor, setting and reason required. Details closed (no password/secret fields): setting, attempted_value, reason required; admin_type required when the actor is an admin (wrong_partner, out_of_range), absent for not_admin; scope.partner_id required when admin_type=partner [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:48 PM].

attempted_value.description: TimeSpan text, e.g. 12:00:00. No range enforced (OQ-40 range open).

reason.description: not_admin: not admin_type super|partner. wrong_partner: a Partner Admin changing another partner's locations (interim scope rule, 7.4). out_of_range: value outside the allowed range (range still open, OQ-40) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:48 PM].
